title: Ioana Petrou
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Ioana Petrou is a judge for Division 3 of the California 1st District Court of Appeal. She assumed office in 2018. Her current term ends on January 4, 2027.
Petrou is running for re-election for the Division 3 judge of the California 1st District Court of Appeal. She is on the ballot in the retention election on November 3, 2026.
On November 21, 2018, Gov. Jerry Brown (D) appointed Petrou to succeed Judge Stuart Pollak. The California Commission on Judicial Appointments confirmed Petrou's appointment on December 21, 2018.
